# Scale

Reads each splat's size along its three local axes.

`lfs.scale` · Input

## How to use

Connect Scale to Separate XYZ to compare axis sizes.  
Values use scene units, not a size multiplier.  

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Scale | `Scale` | lfs.vector | — | — | Size along each splat's three local axes, in scene units. |
